crime_highlights: Mr. Sanderson's shank, wielded by Mr. Sanderson, did inflict an injury upon Germa
Germa sustained a laceration to his right lower chin, a stab wound in the area of his chest and a small abrasion to the area of his left shoulder
The stab wound in his chest in particular required emergency medical attention
He spent about two weeks in hospital
rationale_highlights: Mr. Sanderson is an Aboriginal person and has lived a life of significant deprivation and hardship as a result
Considering the systemic factors that are referred to in the authorities provided
the severely disadvantaged personal background of Mr. Sanderson as a First Nations person
I find a fit sentence within the range of authorities provided to be a three year sentence of imprisonment
note: Court never plainly says culpability reduced; para 64 is defence submission.

rationale_highlights: G.E.W., now 58, is another victim of the residential school system
I recognise G.E.W.'s horrible experience with the residential school system and the effects that has had on him

The complainant was 14 years of age at the time of the offence
Mr. Louie did not use a condom on all of the occasions
rationale_highlights: his father was a victim of the well‑documented historical abuses that were perpetrated against aboriginal people in the residential school system
tailors the disposition to take account of the fact that Mr. Louie comes before the court as an aboriginal offender
